verdict.rationale: Pipecat is an open-source (BSD-2) Python framework that is pip-installable and ran keylessly in a runtime probe. Its docs describe a built-in development runner and say the same bot file is portable to production self-hosting setups, and community users confirm fully local inference via ollama and whisper. missing for 10: a dedicated, in-depth production self-hosting deployment guide (the docs only mention self-hosting setups in passing).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: the open-source voice-agent framework is real, pip-installable, and self-hostable
This is the property that makes the same bot file portable across the development runner, Pipecat Cloud, and most production self-hosting setups.
Open source Python framework for building voice and multimodal AI pipelines.
Local inference is already supported via Pipecat, you can use ollama or any custom OpenAI endpoint.
